A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-recall-depth-pilot
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-18, after the reborn-dl1-recall pilot (run 44293222019: d0 = d1 in all 18 cells; d2 0 deaths
against 1, no DL1 flight Recall) and before any result of this study was read. The owner asked for 1, 2 and 3
up to the big tier. d1 is C's Recall at every depth (identical to 0 by construction, shown in that pilot); d2 is
the shipped default (no flight Recall on DL1 without 5 known breeders or 3 awake monsters that can move within
6 grids); d3 extends the same gate to DL2. Tiers run in order (pilot, small, medium, big); each only after the
previous gate passes.
Gate:
- no config_error; one binary; each arm's value in borg.txt;
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified;
- death bundles reproduced.
Report per arm: deaths and causes, final level, deepest level; paired rescued and newly killed, d2 and d3 against
d1 (exact McNemar). Where evidence is kept (pilot, small): flight Recall notes per game and their depth, Recall
scrolls read, DL1-2 stands.
